crossRefs.note: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me…
The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…
With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

translations.web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
translations.bsb: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.
translations.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
translations.asv: With many other exhortations therefore preached he good tidings unto the people;
